messages.subject: llply and prallel
parts:
I am trying out the parallel examples e.g.

require(plyr)
require(doSMP)
workers<-startWorkers(2)
registerDoSMP(workers)

x <-seq_len(20)
wait <-function(i) Sys.sleep(0.1)
tm1=system.time(llply(x, wait))
tm2=system.time(llply(x, wait, .parallel = TRUE))

But if I have a function that calls another function then llply can´t
find it e.g.

wait2<-function(i) wait(i)
tm1=system.time(llply(x, wait2))
tm2=system.time(llply(x, wait2, .parallel = TRUE))

error in do.ply(i) : task 1 failed - "could not find function "wait""

Laurie

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: llply and prallel
parts:
Yes, unfortunately there's a bug and .parallel currently only works
with the multicore package.
Hadley
